audit.why: Early poke-and-burst vs. a scaling enchanter whose sustain only compounds after items — EVEN with a late swing to Milio is right, and matches the packet's level-6 flip to Milio.
Level 2 kill pressure, level 6 true damage beating the cleanse-heal, and the late-game flip to Milio's stacked shields/heals are all already stated and match the packet chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions rule your-channel-punished claims Milio can cancel Life Form Disintegration Ray with Breath of Life (R), but Milio's R targets and heals allies — it does not apply CC to enemies, so it cannot interrupt your channel.
audit.why: enemyKit.R's own description is 'heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range' — an ally-target cleanse, not a hard-CC cast on the owner. The hardCC flag on it looks like a tooltip-parsing misfire; the description overrides it per the kit-authority rule.
audit.corrected: Do not add a channel-cancel warning for Milio R; instead note his R cleanses your CC off his carry but does nothing against your true damage.

edits.before: Q-fork the pair, W the pulse, third-hit the research — true math their page can't answer.
edits.after: Land a third hit for the Organic Deconstruction proc — the true-damage burst ignores his shields and heals entirely.

edits.before: Beaming into a loaded engage — the channel is a verdict for fights already decided.
edits.after: Breath of Life cleanses CC but not damage — beam without landing E's knockup first and he just walks the target out of range.
edits.note: removes COPY_PASTE_BLEED from tradeBad; corrected to reflect Milio R being a cleanse, not a stun

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Tectonic Disruption banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Breath of Life is a long 160/145/130s cooldown — force it early with real damage, then engage once it's down. - Tectonic Disruption (E) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The 100/90/80s R is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Late Vel'Koz grades teamfights: E the entry, beam the formation, and fork the survivors.
edits.after: Milio's stacked shields, cleanse ult and Warmth passive out-sustain your poke into two-plus items — force picks before his backline is protected.

edits.before: You decide fights from range: root the entry, zone the pit, and bill the formation.
edits.after: He decides fights from here: shields and cleanse keep his backline healthy through your poke, so catch someone out of position with E-detonate into R before his peel is set.
